_comment: Grow's numbers. The rules that use them are in lib/grow.js.
_clean-days: How many different days a step must be said with every word right before it counts as mastered. One clean run can be luck or a fresh memory; the same words right again on another day is what knowing them looks like. The score counts only mastered steps.
_storage-key: Where the reader's record is kept in this browser. Nothing of it leaves the device except the anonymous attempt lib/progress.js already sends for every module.
